WITH combined AS (
  SELECT "Centre" AS centre, "Month" AS month, "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolled, "Avg Daily Present" AS present, 2023 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2023"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "centre_name" AS centre, "month" AS month, "enrolment" AS enrolled, "average_attendance" AS present, 2024 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2024"
),
turnout AS (
  SELECT 
    centre,
    year,
    SUM(present) AS total_present,
    SUM(enrolled) AS total_enrolled,
    CASE 
      WHEN SUM(enrolled) IS NULL OR SUM(enrolled) = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (SUM(present) * 100.0) / SUM(enrolled)
    END AS turnout_pct
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY centre, year
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.centre,
    t1.turnout_pct AS pct_2023,
    t2.turnout_pct AS pct_2024,
    (t2.turnout_pct - t1.turnout_pct) AS drop
  FROM turnout t1
  JOIN turnout t2 ON t1.centre = t2.centre AND t1.year = 2023 AND t2.year = 2024
)
SELECT centre, pct_2023, pct_2024, drop
FROM ranked
ORDER BY drop ASC;
